Bonsai 27B: Full 27B-Class Reasoning in Binary and Ternary Transformer Weights — On Laptops and Phones
hot.summary: PrismML introduces a post-training quantization technique that compresses a 27-billion parameter language model into binary (1.125 bpw) and ternary (1.71 bpw) formats, reducing its size to as little as 3.9 GB while preserving between 89.5% and 94.6% of its original intelligence on a comprehensive benchmark suite. This enables interactive inference on consumer laptops and high-end smartphones.

hot.title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
hot.summary: This research introduces FlowWAM, a framework that utilizes optical flow as a unified, video-native action representation for World Action Models (WAMs). It achieves state-of-the-art success rates in robot manipulation tasks and significantly improves the reliability of action-conditioned world modeling by providing dense, cross-frame motion cues.

hot.title: Inside TPU and GPU Clusters: The Anatomy of Collective Communication
Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents
hot.summary: Tencent Robotics X introduced Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an embodied foundation model designed for physical-world agents, which achieves competitive performance across 38 diagnostic benchmarks and in closed-loop navigation. Utilizing a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, it processes information with only 3 billion active parameters, improving average scores by 4.4 percentage points over the strongest comparable baseline while maintaining high efficiency.

hot.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
hot.summary: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 introduces a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive world model that unifies general image/video generation with embodied synthesis, preserving foundation model generalization while adapting to robot-centric multi-view reasoning and interaction. The system achieved superior multi-view consistency and instruction following compared to existing models, and augmented data generated by it improved real-world robot policy robustness by enhancing task completion progress in interference conditions from 36.9% to 63.2%.

Quantum States Prepared by Wormholes: Long-Wavelength Deviations from Bunch-Davies
hot.summary: This research from I. Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University and Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics determines the quantum state of cosmological perturbations generated by wineglass wormholes, finding small, scale-dependent deviations from the Bunch-Davies vacuum for long-wavelength modes that are proportional to the wormhole's charge. These deviations vanish in the zero-charge limit, supporting a smooth topological transition to no-boundary instantons and implying potential observable imprints on the cosmic microwave background.

hot.title: Qwen-Music Technical Report
hot.summary: Qwen-Music presents a unified framework for controllable, high-fidelity song generation that separates semantic composition from acoustic rendering to produce complete vocal singing. The model achieves competitive subjective quality against leading systems like Suno V5.5 and ranks first in 13 out of 16 objective dimensions on bilingual text-to-music benchmarks.

hot.title: WanToFight: Real-Time Generative Game Engine for Multi-Player Combat Interaction
hot.summary: WANTOFIGHT is a generative game engine that simulates real-time, two-player KOF '97 combat from keyboard inputs, uniquely integrating multi-player control, real-time inference, complex physical interaction, and adversarial gameplay. The system achieves 30 FPS generation at 512x384 resolution, demonstrating consistent character identity binding and responsive combat physics over extended matches.

hot.title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
hot.summary: A dense vision-language reward model, DenseReward, was developed to provide fine-grained, per-timestep feedback for robotic manipulation tasks by employing an automated pipeline for synthesizing diverse, physically realistic failure data. The model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.081 in dense reward prediction, surpassing existing models, and improved success rates in real-world robotic tasks by up to 40 percentage points.

hot.title: UniVR: Thinking in Visual Space for Unified Visual Reasoning
hot.summary: UniVR introduces a framework that enables AI models to learn complex reasoning, physical dynamics, and long-term planning directly from visual demonstrations, operating natively in visual space. The system improves performance on the VR-X benchmark by 18.4% in VLM score and 20.61 in JEPA compared to prior unified generative models, achieving greater logical coherence and physical consistency in generated visual sequences.

PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
hot.summary: PalmClaw is an on-device agent framework for mobile phones that utilizes structured device tools to enable large language models to directly access and control phone capabilities. It achieves a 97.1% task success rate, significantly reducing task completion time by 94.9% and requiring fewer actions and tokens compared to existing GUI-based mobile agents.

hot.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
hot.summary: A comprehensive survey from Yale University and UC Irvine provides the first organized overview of metacognition in large language models. The report clarifies foundational concepts, reviews current progress in measuring and implementing these abilities, and finds that while LLMs show basic metacognitive traits, significant limitations remain, necessitating further research into dedicated methods for enhancement.

hot.title: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space
hot.summary: The AMAP CV Lab of Alibaba Group developed ABot-3DWorld 0, a universal multimodal 3D world model that converts diverse inputs (text, image, video) into explorable 3D Gaussian Splatting worlds. This system unifies input processing via a Spatial Generative Primitive and achieves enhanced 3D consistency and aesthetic quality, demonstrating improved fidelity compared to existing methods on various scene categories.

hot.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
hot.summary: Researchers introduce SpectraReward, a training-free reward model for text-to-image generation that reuses frozen multimodal large language models' (MLLMs) image-text alignment capabilities. This approach consistently improves generation performance and enables Unified Multimodal Models to self-improve, with their intrinsic understanding branch matching or exceeding much larger external reward models.

hot.title: ChunkFlow: Towards Continuity-Consistent Chunked Policy Learning
hot.summary: ChunkFlow presents a framework for continuity-consistent chunked policy learning in robotic manipulation, mitigating temporal discontinuities and boundary jitter in Vision-Language Action models. The approach integrates seam-aware training, deterministic overlap blending, and regularization, leading to improved task success, enhanced action smoothness, and minimal inference latency across various benchmarks.

hot.title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
hot.summary: A self-supervised "function-aware Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM)" mid-training stage enhances coding agent foundation models, improving performance on SWE-Bench benchmarks by up to +5.40 points and mitigating capability degradation on other coding and tool-use tasks by an average of +3.52 points. The method explicitly aligns models with structural dependencies found in both function calls and agentic reasoning loops.

hot.title: Do AI Agents Know When a Task Is Simple? Toward Complexity-Aware Reasoning and Execution
hot.summary: Researchers from the University of Tennessee and Microsoft developed the E3 (Estimate, Execute, Expand) framework, enabling LLM agents to predict task complexity and required execution scope before acting. This approach reduced computational costs and resource consumption for software engineering tasks by up to 84.9% while maintaining a 100% success rate on a controlled benchmark.

likes.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
likes.summary: Researchers from Meta AI developed a proactive memory agent that runs alongside an action agent, selectively injecting concise, memory-grounded reminders into the action agent's context. This mechanism effectively addresses "behavioral state decay" and consistently improves success rates on complex, long-horizon tasks like command-line execution and conversational tool use.

likes.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
likes.summary: GenCeption, a generalist video perception model from Google DeepMind, repurposes a pre-trained text-to-video diffusion model into an efficient, feed-forward architecture. It achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse vision tasks like depth estimation, surface normal prediction, segmentation, and 3D keypoint estimation, exhibiting robust generalization from synthetic to real-world data and out-of-distribution categories.

likes.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
likes.summary: Researchers at HKUST identified that Large Language Models often fail to generalize memorized facts in reasoning tasks due to a "knowledge–circuit misalignment," where new information is stored but not effectively routed to the middle computational layers crucial for multi-step reasoning. A novel "self-patching" intervention revealed this dynamic, demonstrating that strategically re-routing these representations can recover 58-75% of the potential generalization performance.

likes.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
likes.summary: LingBot-VA 2.0 introduces a video-action foundation model specifically engineered for embodied robot control, utilizing a native causal architecture and a semantic visual-action tokenizer. This approach achieves a 14.0 percentage point improvement in average success rate on the RoboTwin benchmark and an end-to-end inference speedup of 6.5x, enabling real-time closed-loop control at up to 225 Hz asynchronous execution.

Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
likes.summary: A framework for Visual Pretraining (VP) is introduced, enabling large foundation models to learn directly from raw visual scientific documents without explicit text extraction. This approach consistently improves performance on scientific reasoning and multimodal benchmarks, fostering better cross-modal alignment while utilizing more compact data representations compared to text-only pretraining.

likes.title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
likes.summary: A modular post-training framework for large language models, Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), is presented, which separates policy exploration using a lightweight proxy model from the alignment of a more capable primary model. This approach extracts and calibrates relative improvement signals for efficient transfer, yielding up to a +30.2 average performance gain for Qwen3-8B in math and +4.6 in code over base models while significantly reducing computational overhead.

likes.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
likes.summary: Li Auto Inc.'s Mach-Mind-4-Flash model, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with 3B activated parameters, attains performance comparable to or surpassing models in the 100B to 1T parameter range across diverse agentic tasks and reasoning benchmarks. This capability is achieved through an advanced post-training pipeline focused on reinforcement learning and distillation, rather than scaling pre-training compute.

likes.summary: An on-policy self-distillation framework, OPSD-V, is introduced to post-train few-step autoregressive video generators, leveraging real long-video data as privileged temporal context. This approach improves long-horizon video quality and motion dynamics for existing models, achieving quantitative gains on VBenchLong without increasing inference costs.

likes.title: Harness VLA: Steering Frozen VLAs into Reliable Manipulation Primitives via Memory-Guided Agents
likes.summary: A memory-augmented agentic framework called Harness VLA allows frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to reliably execute manipulation tasks despite semantic and spatial distribution shifts. It orchestrates a VLA as a retryable contact-rich primitive using an LLM-driven planner, achieving an 82.4% success rate on the perturbed LIBERO-Pro benchmark and a 25.4 percentage point improvement over baselines on RoboCasa365 household tasks.

likes.title: TSRouter: Dynamic Modality-Model Selection for Time Series Reasoning
likes.summary: A graph-based framework, TSROUTER, dynamically selects the most suitable input modality and large foundation model for each time series reasoning query, achieving substantial accuracy improvements up to 46% relative to baselines and demonstrating robust generalization with low latency.

likes.title: HyperLoRA: Generating Implicit Neural Fields in Weight Space with LoRA Parameters
likes.summary: HyperLoRA transforms implicit neural fields into structured LoRA parameters, enabling semantic manipulation and efficient conditional generation of 3D and 4D content. The framework generates high-fidelity outputs comparable to existing methods, while reducing storage overhead by 99.3% compared to HyperDiffusion and demonstrating robust semantic interpolation and multimodal conditioning.
